The structure of composition Mg2Mn2Sb4O16 (MgMn(SbO4)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2_1/c (No. 14), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg and Mn centers each in octahedral environments coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sb centers show a tetrahedral O environment. Corner-sharing is observed between Mg and Mn octahedra and between Mg octahedra and Sb tetrahedra, with edge-sharing also present between Mn octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
